securityAcceptance: Pending explicit review of CVE-2025-52290 before production activation. Other findings assessed against the restricted patched build; no blanket waiver.

CVE-2025-52290.review: Undetermined upstream. Pinned H.264 helper has null-context/SPS guards, the reported MPEG-TS demuxer is not compiled, and input is forced MOV. Explicit security review remains required before production activation; no zero-CVE claim.
